result.instructions: Tools for Ablefy (elopage), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the products in my Ablefy account."; "Which invoices were issued last month, and which of them are still unpaid?"; "Look up payment 12345 and tell me its state.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ablefy (elopage) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run elopage_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run elopage_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run elopage_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. elopage_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: elopage_get_me
tools.title: Show the connected account
tools.description: Check that the API key and secret work and return the account they belong to. Good first call. Ablefy API: GET /api/me.

tools.name: elopage_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products of the account. Ablefy API: GET /api/products.

tools.name: elopage_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id. Ablefy API: GET /api/products/{id}.

product_id.description: The id from a list tool, as text.

tools.name: elopage_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id. Ablefy API: GET /api/orders/{id}.

order_id.description: The id from a list tool, as text.

tools.name: elopage_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment by id. This read never refunds: the server never sends the refund amount parameter. Ablefy API: GET /api/payments/{id}.

payment_id.description: The id from a list tool, as text.

tools.name: elopage_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices and credit notes, filtered by date, invoice state, payment state or product. Without dates the API uses its default range. Ablefy API: GET /api/invoices.

predefined_date_range.description: A fixed range. It overrides date_from and date_to.

invoice_state.description: Filter by invoice state. Credit notes appear as issued; non_payable is an alias the API accepts.

tools.name: elopage_list_funnels
tools.title: List funnels
tools.description: List the sales funnels of the account. Ablefy API: GET /api/funnels.

tools.name: elopage_get_funnel
tools.title: Get a funnel
tools.description: Get one sales funnel by id. Ablefy API: GET /api/funnels/{id}.

funnel_id.description: The id from a list tool, as text.

tools.name: elopage_list_event_tickets
tools.title: List event tickets
tools.description: List the e-tickets of one event, optionally only those updated since a date. Ablefy API: GET /api/events/{id}/e_tickets.

event_id.description: The id from a list tool, as text.

last_updated_date.description: Only tickets updated at or after this date-time.

tools.name: elopage_list_pricing_plans
tools.title: List pricing plans
tools.description: List the pricing plans of the account. Ablefy API: GET /api/pricing_plans.

tools.name: elopage_list_publishers
tools.title: List publishers
tools.description: List the publishers (partners) of the account. Ablefy API: GET /api/publishers.

tools.name: elopage_list_affiliate_redirections
tools.title: List affiliate redirections
tools.description: List the affiliate redirections of the account. Ablefy API: GET /api/affiliate_redirections.

tools.name: elopage_list_webhook_endpoints
tools.title: List webhook endpoints
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints of the account. Ablefy API: GET /api/webhook_endpoints.

tools.name: elopage_get_transfer
tools.title: Get a transfer
tools.description: Get one transfer by id. Ablefy API: GET /api/transfers/{id}.

transfer_id.description: The id from a list tool, as text.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Ablefy (elopage)
prompts.description: What you can do with Ablefy (elopage) here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_account_and_list_the_products
prompts.title: Check the account and list the products
prompts.description: Check that the API key and secret work and see the connected account. Then list the products and open one by its id to read its details.

prompts.name: find_invoices_that_are_still_unpaid
prompts.title: Find invoices that are still unpaid
prompts.description: List invoices and credit notes for a date range, and filter them by invoice or payment state. Open an order by its id to read its details.

prompts.name: look_up_a_payment_order_or_transfer
prompts.title: Look up a payment, order or transfer
prompts.description: Look up one payment, order or transfer by its id. Read the state of a payment there. The payment lookup cannot issue a refund.

prompts.name: review_funnels_and_pricing_plans
prompts.title: Review funnels and pricing plans
prompts.description: List the sales funnels and open one by its id to read its details. List the pricing plans of the account in the same review.

prompts.name: check_event_tickets_and_webhook_endpoints
prompts.title: Check event tickets and webhook endpoints
prompts.description: List the e-tickets of one event, optionally only those updated since a date. List the webhook endpoints set up on the account.
